direct.instructions: Investigate the permitted source and Work records. Write natural prose in the requested language with exact input and byte-range citations. Distinguish code observations, original reports, choices, checks and missing information. Choose the reading order yourself.

note_then_prose.instructions: Investigate the permitted source and Work records. First write a concise cited technical note separating observations and interpretations. Then write natural prose in the requested language with exact citations. Choose the reading order yourself. Preserve choices, checks and missing information.
note_then_prose.output: technical note and prose; both charged to the same total budget
